review.notes: Whole-document PDF-text vs OCR diff plus code-fence/heading scan over all 25 physical pages. The Figure 1 demo bubbles (French query, 'Honorable guests...' response) and chart-only labels are inside embedded figures and were not transcribed, matching the source images. Physical p15 prints the author typo 'In constrast'; the OCR reads 'In contrast', which is kept (author typo, not patched). The contributors footnote and five reference URLs were verified on 300-dpi renders.
